name: soundcraft-plugin
description: Make, mix and render audio in SoundCraft from Claude: the soundcraft MCP server (live app or headless), plus skills for driving SoundCraft and for procedural audio (synthesis, granular processing, procedural variation, physics-driven sound).

mode.title: Connection mode
mode.description: auto: drive a running SoundCraft (started with --control PORT) and fall back to headless. connect: the running app only. headless: an in-process engine, no app needed.

control_port.title: Control port
control_port.description: Loopback port the SoundCraft app listens on when started with --control PORT.

cli_path.title: soundcraft-cli path
cli_path.description: Absolute path to soundcraft-cli (or its folder). Leave empty to search PATH and the usual install folders.

demo.title: Start from the demo session (headless)
demo.description: Headless only: start the engine with SoundCraft's demo session instead of an empty one (--demo).

read_roots.title: Read roots (optional)
read_roots.description: Existing folders the agent may read from (open, import, sampler load, presets). Setting any read or write root confines file access and forces headless mode.

write_roots.title: Write roots (optional)
write_roots.description: Existing folders the agent may save, bounce and export into. Setting any read or write root confines file access and forces headless mode.
